name: ERA5 and ERA5-Land
access: ERA5-land and ERA5 reanalysis datasets are available from the Climate Data Store (https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.adbb2d47, https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.bd0915c6, https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.e2161bac )

scales.note: ERA5 and ERA5-Land reprocessed to 1x1 degree spatial resolution and non-overlapping 3-day means spanning 1950 to 2023.
